messages:
Alex M: Quick sync — Parklet meetup next Wed. Packing list: booth backdrop, 2 monitors, demo laptop, QR stack, swag (hoodies + stickers), speaker handout. Also need final launch post copy and a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb for Mateo to design assets.
Priya S: Got it. Printly pickup confirmed 3/28 09:00. Who's bringing the demo laptop and dongles?
Mateo G: I can bring demo laptop + monitors. Need final 1200x627 hero + short tagline for booth card by Tue noon. Also will need one high-res chart for the benchmark slide.
Sam W: For inbound leads flow: QR -> Typeform -> Zap -> HubSpot. Routing rules: tag submissions with "parklet-2026" and assign to AE rotation. UTM plan: utm_campaign=parklet2026&utm_source=qr&utm_medium=print. I'll provision the Zap and test.
Riley C: Swag counts recommendation: 50 hoodies (S-XL split 15/20/10/5), 500 stickers, 200 postcards, 30 branded power banks. Order 10 extra hoodies for staff. ETA vendor lead time 10 days.
Alex M: Draft LinkedIn posts (A/B) for review — keep punchy:
Post A: "We cut inference costs by 3x while keeping sub-50ms latency. Come see Redwood Inference at Parklet — demos at Booth 7, live microtalk at 11:20. Sign up for a quick webinar: redwood.com/parklet"
Post B: "Low-latency LLMs, lower cost. Join Redwood Inference at Parklet — demo + microtalk. Quick sign-ups at the booth. #inference #llm"
Mateo G: I like B for the booth hero (clean, short). Will mock both assets and bring print proofs to pickup. Emphasize "3x" visually for A.
Priya S: Speaking lineup: 2 submissions accepted, one slot open at 11:20. Sam, can you cover the benchmark narrative — 6-min microtalk focusing on throughput vs cost tradeoffs?
Sam W: Yep — I can do the 6-min microtalk. Will prepare 3 slides: problem, approach (routing + batching + quantization), results (cost/latency chart) and link to eval repo. Also will create a one-paragraph benchmark blurb for the booth card.
Sam W: QR config example for ops: https://redwood.typeform.com/to/parklet?utm_campaign=parklet2026&utm_source=qr&utm_medium=print
Riley C: Shipping address for Printly drop-off: Redwood Inference, Attn: Events — 88 Teal St, San Francisco, CA 94107. Alex, can you sign off on the label? I can finalize pickup after sign-off.
Alex M: Signed. I'll post final checklist tonight and share the shipping label. Staff rota draft: Fri 09:00-12:00 Priya + Alex, 12:00-15:00 Mateo + Sam, 15:00-18:00 Alex + Riley.
evt-bot: deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Parklet Meetup — Booth 7 — 2026-03-31 09:00-18:00.
Priya S: Final ask: Mateo, pls bring a spare HDMI->USB-C adapter and a USB-C power strip. Sam, please prepare the short webinar signup flow (one-click + email capture) we can demo at the booth.
Alex M: Thanks all — action items: Mateo: assets by Tue noon; Sam: Zap + webinar flow by Tue EOD; Riley: shipping labels and pickup; Priya: on-site check-in and speaker cue. Will follow up with a single Google doc checklist.
